messages.text: Hey, I just received the large beach scene poster, but it's way smaller than the website said and the colors look washed out compared to the preview.

I'm really sorry to hear that the item didn't meet your expectations. If you can send us a photo of the poster next to a standard ruler so we can verify the size discrepancy, we will refund $75 to your original payment method.
That sounds good. I will take a photo with a ruler right now and upload it to the order details page as soon as I'm done.
Thanks for your patience. Please let us know once the photo is uploaded so we can process the refund as promised.
Hi, I just bought a pair of running shoes last week and the soles have completely peeled off after only three runs. This is really frustrating since they were supposed to last much longer.

I'm so sorry to hear that your new shoes failed so quickly. That is definitely not the experience we want for you. Could you please send me a few photos of the damage so I can document the issue for you?

Sure, here are the photos showing the sole separating from the upper. You can clearly see the glue coming away. I need this resolved as soon as possible because I was counting on these for my morning runs.

Thanks for sending those images; it is clear there is a defect. We will accept a return for these items and I will send you a prepaid return label within the next hour so you can ship them back easily.
Hi, I purchased a cast iron skillet last week and I still haven't received it. The tracking says it was delivered in 2019, which seems wrong. Can you help?
I'm sorry to hear that. Our records show the order was marked as delivered on that date. Have you checked with family or neighbors just in case it was left nearby?
I've asked everyone and checked every porch in the building. It's definitely not here. What are my options now?
If you can confirm in writing with a brief statement that the item is missing, we will ship a replacement cast iron pan to you.
Hi, I just got my poster and the colors look completely different from the photos. It's way too dark and the font is blurry. I didn't order this at all.
I'm really sorry to hear that, that's definitely not what we want for you. I will cancel the order before it ships by tomorrow at 5 PM so you don't have to worry about receiving the wrong item.
Okay, that's good. I was worried I'd have to deal with the hassle of sending it back since the packaging is already open. Thanks for handling this quickly.
You're welcome. I've noted the cancellation request in our system and I will make sure it doesn't get sent out. Let me know if you have any other questions.
I tried to cancel my wool sweater subscription last week, but I got charged again this month. Please help me stop these charges.
I'm sorry about that. If you reply to this chat with your account email address within the next 24 hours, I will cancel your subscription.
Here is my email: user@example.com. Can you confirm it's stopped now?
Hi, I ordered a clear phone case last week but it still hasn't shown up. Can you check on it?
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into the tracking details for your order right now to see where it is.
Thanks. I checked the carrier's website and it says the package was lost in transit, so I need some help resolving this.
I see that it is marked as lost. I will issue you store credit for the full amount so you can pick a different case once the inventory refreshes next week.
Okay, that works for me. Please send that to my account as soon as you can.
Hi, I canceled my monthly fabric subscription but the charge for the backpack went through again today. I didn't expect that.
I'm sorry to hear that. If you upload a screenshot of the transaction to our support portal by end of day tomorrow, I will reverse the duplicate charge for you within 24 hours.
Okay, I have the receipt ready. I'll upload it right now so you can process the reversal.
Thanks. I've noted your ticket and will ensure the money is returned to your original payment method within the stated timeframe once the document is verified.

Hi, I just bought a pair of running shoes last week and they completely fell apart after only a few runs. The soles are peeling off. I've already opened a dispute in PayPal, can you help me sort this out?
I am very sorry to hear that your shoes failed so quickly. I will handle the matter through your open PayPal dispute and respond there directly to resolve the issue.
Thanks for the quick reply. I appreciate you addressing this through the dispute channel. I hope we can reach a solution soon.
You are welcome. I will keep an eye on the dispute case and provide my response there as soon as possible.
Great, I will wait for your update in the portal. Thanks again.
Hi, I just noticed I was charged twice for the same pair of wireless earbuds. Can you check your system and fix this error?

Hello, I understand your concern. According to our billing policy, third-party payment processors occasionally show pending charges that may not finalize as duplicate transactions. We do not have the ability to intervene in bank-level billing cycles or issue manual corrections directly from our support platform.
That's not what I asked for. I want you to reverse the second charge on your end so I don't have to deal with my bank.

I apologize, but our system does not permit agents to alter finalized transaction records or initiate reversals. All billing adjustments must be processed through the original payment method's issuer. We recommend contacting your bank for any discrepancies regarding double charges.
Hey, I just opened my mechanical keyboard package and it's missing the spacebar and the wrist rest. Can you fix this?

That is so sorry to hear that! We will ship a replacement set containing the spacebar and wrist rest to you by Friday, and we will refund $30 to your original payment method by the same day to cover the inconvenience.
Thanks for the quick reply. Do I need to return the broken box or just keep the keyboard as is?
No need to return anything. Please just keep the keyboard you received before the replacement parts arrive.
Perfect, looking forward to getting the missing pieces. Have a good day!
Hi, I just opened my order and the wool sweater is shredded in several places. Please look into this.
I am so sorry to hear that. If you can email us a photo of the damage, we will refund $30 to your original payment method.
That sounds good. I am sending the photos to your support inbox right now.
Thanks, we usually review photos within 24 hours. Please keep an eye on your email for confirmation once processed.
Got it, I sent them. Hope the fix goes through quickly.
Hi, I just realized I ordered the wrong mechanical keyboard by mistake. I need the software version, not the wireless one I got. Can I return it?

Sorry to hear about the mix-up! We can accept the return, and we will send you a prepaid return label or arrange a pickup once you confirm you have repacked the item securely in its original box. Please let us know within 48 hours that you are ready to send it back so we can proceed.
Okay, I have it boxed up now and am ready to send it back. Please go ahead with the label.
Hi, I just received the keyboard I ordered last week. The listing said it had linear switches, but these are definitely clicky. This is not what I expected at all.
I am very sorry to hear that the switches are incorrect. We will ship a replacement keyboard with the correct linear switches to you as soon as possible, and you can simply dispose of the wrong one.
Okay, that is fine then. I will wait for the new one to arrive. Thanks for sorting this out quickly.
Hi, I just received my mechanical keyboard and it completely stopped working after I used it for only a week. It's dead now. I need to send it back immediately.
I am so sorry to hear that. I have checked the status and it is not yet in transit, so I will cancel the order before it ships to resolve this issue.
Thank you so much for handling this quickly. I appreciate you taking care of it right away since the product is broken out of the box.
Hi, I just realized the keyboard I bought is way bigger than my desk space allows. I ordered a full-size one but I meant to get a compact model.
Sorry to hear that! We can certainly help look into a solution for you. Could you please provide your order number so I can check the details?

Sure thing, the order number is #88234. Since I keep buying the wrong accessories, I was actually hoping to switch to a monthly subscription for keyboards so I can swap them out easily. Can you set that up?
I understand the frustration. I will cancel your subscription as requested to stop any future charges associated with that plan.
Hi, I ordered a keyboard two weeks ago and it still hasn't shown up. I have a delivery window that's already passed and no tracking updates. Can you check what's going on?

I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into your order. It seems a package may have been lost in transit. We mark your order as closed for now, so it won't come through. Please let me know if you'd like to try a different size instead.
Yes, please. I actually prefer a smaller keyboard, like a 75% layout. Can you send me a link to the one I want?
Absolutely. I will arrange an exchange for the 75% model for you. Please provide the specific model number you want within the next 24 hours so I can process it. Thanks for your patience.
Hi, I just realized I ordered the wrong vase by mistake. It's the big blue one. Can you help me? I haven't paid for it yet.
Sorry to hear that! Since the invoice is still unpaid, I will cancel the unpaid invoice for you right away.
That sounds great, thank you. I was worried about being billed for the wrong item.
Hi, my phone case was supposed to arrive on Tuesday but it's been three days and there's no update on the tracking. I need it for a work event this weekend.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can see the tracking is stuck. Since you've already opened a dispute, I will handle the matter through your open PayPal dispute and respond there shortly.
Okay, that works. I'll keep an eye on the dispute for your response. Thanks for getting back to me.
Hi, I just received the ceramic vase I ordered last week. The product page said it was a glossy white finish, but the one I got is matte and off-white. It looks completely different from the photos.

I'm so sorry to hear that the item didn't match your expectations. I completely understand why you're upset about the difference in finish. Would you prefer us to process a refund for the item or send out a replacement that matches the description?
To be honest, I don't think I want to wait for another shipment that might also be wrong. I think I'd just like my money back so I can look for a different vase elsewhere.

Got it. I understand you want to make sure you get exactly what you're looking for. I've made a note of your preference for a refund to forward to the resolution team. They will review the case and reach out with the next steps shortly.
Thanks for noting that down. I'll keep an eye out for an email from the team today. Have a good day.
Hi, I just opened my monthly snack box and noticed the trail mix bag is missing and the chocolate bar bag is ripped open.

I am so sorry to hear that! Please email us a photo of the box and the damaged item, and once we receive it, we will ship a replacement chocolate bar and set up a prepaid return label for you to send back the defective packaging.
Okay, I'll send those photos over right now, thanks for the quick help.
Hi, I believe I was charged twice for my new board game. I only ordered one copy but see two transactions on my statement.
I'm sorry about that. I checked your account and confirmed the duplicate charge. We will refund $9.99 to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
That is great. Is there anything I need to do on my end to trigger that? I can't wait for the money to come back.
No, there is nothing you need to do. The refund is already being processed on our side, so you should see it appear in your bank account within the timeframe mentioned.
Perfect, thanks for the quick help. I'll keep an eye out for it.
Hi, I just opened my package and the silicone band for the case is missing. I only got the main case part.
I'm so sorry to hear that! That sounds frustrating. Could you please send us a quick photo of the empty box and the parts you received so we can verify the order details?
Sure, here is the photo of the box and the case. You can see the spot where the band should be, but it's definitely not there.

Thanks for the picture. Since we can confirm the part is missing, we will accept a return once you upload that photo to your order portal. We will then send you a prepaid return label so you can ship it back.
Okay, I will go ahead and upload the photo to the portal now. Let me know if you need anything else from my end.
Hi, I just opened my package and the box for the strategy game is flat on one side. The cardboard is crushed and looks like it might have been stepped on.
I'm so sorry to hear that. That sounds like a rough delivery. Could you please send us a photo of the damage so we can document the issue for our records?
Here is the photo you asked for. It definitely looks bad. I hope I can still get a new one without too much hassle.
Thanks for the photo. We will ship a replacement item to you, and it will leave our warehouse by tomorrow evening.
Hey, I canceled my subscription for the stainless steel water bottle last week, but I just got charged again today. Why is this happening?
Hi there, I'm sorry for the confusion. It looks like the cancellation request didn't process correctly in our system, which caused the renewal to go through automatically.
That's frustrating. I definitely clicked cancel on the 12th. Can you please fix this so I don't keep getting charged every month?
I apologize for the inconvenience. I have updated your account settings to stop the recurring billing, and I will cancel the current order before it ships so you are not charged for this item.
Thanks, that should be all I need. Just make sure the next statement doesn't show any new charges for the bottle.
Hi, the mechanical keyboard I bought from you is completely dead after just one week of use. No lights, no input. Can I get a refund or a replacement please?
I am very sorry to hear that. To prevent you from being charged again, we will pause your subscription by the end of this week.
Okay, thanks. So if it gets fixed and shipped to me, that should be enough. I really needed this for work.
You're welcome. Please keep the defective unit available in case we need to inspect it later, as pausing the subscription is the only action we are taking right now.
Hi, my coffee grinder finally arrived today but it was three days later than the estimated delivery date. Is there anything you can do about the late shipment?
I'm really sorry about the delay. If you send us a photo of the package label and the tracking details showing the late date, we will issue you some store credit as an apology.
Okay, that works for me. I'll take the photos and email them over right now.
Hey, I got my cast iron skillet today but it's missing the helper handle and the paper insert. I can't use it like this.

I'm sorry to hear that! I also see that you were accidentally charged twice for the same order. Please reply to this email with a clear photo of the missing parts and your order number so I can look into it.
Here are the photos you asked for. Order number is #123456. The box was empty where those pieces should be.
Thanks for the photos. Since you've provided the proof, I will reverse the duplicate charge on your credit card within 3 business days.
Great, thanks for sorting out the extra charge so fast.
Hey, I just got the backpack and it's way too small. I ordered the 30L but this one is actually the 20L size. Can you do something about this?
I'm so sorry about the mix-up. Since you've already opened a dispute, I will handle the matter through your open PayPal dispute and respond there shortly.
Okay, that sounds fine. I just need the right size for my upcoming trip so hopefully it gets sorted out quickly.
Understood, I'll make sure to post a detailed reply in the dispute channel as soon as I can so we can resolve this efficiently.
Thanks for letting me know. I'll keep an eye out for your message in the PayPal notification center.
Hi, I just got my package today and the phone case is way too big. It doesn't fit my phone at all. Can you help me sort this out?
I'm sorry to hear that you received the wrong item. Let me check with our warehouse team to see what happened with your order. I'll get back to you as soon as I have more information.
That would be great, thanks. Just making sure, is there a specific timeframe for when I might hear back?
We are looking into it right now. I can't give you an exact time yet, but I will reply here as soon as the warehouse team provides an update.
Hey there, I just took the strap out of the box and it's definitely too big for my wrist. I think I ordered the wrong size. What can we do about this?

Sorry to hear that! If you can send us a quick photo of the strap next to your wrist so we can confirm the fit issue, we will then refund $24.50 and give you an exchange for a different size right away.
Okay, holding on. Let me get my phone and snap a picture for you.

Hi, I just got a message that my mechanical keyboard arrived, but after a week of use, the spacebar stopped responding completely. I tried cleaning it and reseating the switch, but it's still dead. What can I do?
I'm sorry to hear that. If you can send us a quick video of the issue, we will refund $24.50 to your original payment method.
Okay, that sounds fair. I'll record a short clip showing the spacebar failing to register and upload it to the support portal right now.
Thank you. Once we review the footage and confirm the defect, the refund will be processed immediately.
Great, I've uploaded the video. Let me know when the refund goes through so I can close this ticket.

Hi, I just got my earbuds and they are not the color listed in the product photo. The site said midnight blue, but these are clearly silver. I'm really disappointed since I bought them for a specific reason.
I am so sorry to hear that the color does not match your expectations. Let me check the listing details for a moment to see if there was a mislabeling on our end or if it is a standard variation.
I checked the listing again and it definitely says midnight blue with no disclaimer about color variations. I would like to send these back since they are not what I ordered.
We will accept the return and send you a prepaid label once you have uploaded a photo of the earbuds in their original packaging to confirm the color mismatch.
That sounds fair. I will take a photo of the box and the earbuds right now and upload it to the support portal so you can proceed with the label.
Hi, I just received my wool sweater but it's way too small. Can you help me swap it for a medium?
I'm sorry to hear that. If you send back the tag included in your order with the original item, we will ship a size medium replacement to you.
Got it. Where should I send the tag and the sweater?
Please pack everything in the original box and drop it off at the carrier address listed on your packing slip.
Thanks, I'll get that sent out today.
Hi, I noticed I was charged twice for my monthly photo editing subscription. Can you look into this?
I am sorry to hear that. If you send me the exact date of the second charge via encrypted message, I will cancel the duplicate order before it ships by tomorrow morning.
Thanks, that was a relief. I have sent the details now. Just to be clear, I am not receiving any other compensation or refund for the extra charge, right?
Hi, I cancelled my subscription for the ceramic vase last week, but I just got charged for this month's delivery again. This is the third time this has happened.
I'm so sorry to hear that, that is certainly frustrating. Let me pull up your account details to see why the cancellation didn't take effect properly.
Please do. I don't want any more vases or charges. I just need this stopped permanently so I don't have to keep manually disputing the transaction every month.

I will cancel the subscription for you within 24 hours, but only after you reply to this chat confirming that you want to void the current pending charge as well. Once I have that confirmation, I will process the permanent termination.
Confirmed. Please cancel the subscription and void the pending charge as requested. Thanks for getting this sorted out finally.
Hey, my order for the wireless earbuds is supposed to have arrived two days ago, but I still haven't received anything or a tracking update. Can you check on this for me?
I'm really sorry about the delay with your earbuds. I'll look into the tracking immediately and I will issue you $10 in store credit by end of day tomorrow as an apology for the wait.
Thanks for looking into it. It's frustrating since I need them for a trip this weekend. Please make sure I get that email with the store credit code today.
Understood. I will send that email to you by close of business today. Please keep an eye on your inbox and let us know if you don't see it.
Hi, I just got an email for order #5523. I realized I selected the small 12-cup grinder instead of the large 40-cup model I actually need for my office. I haven't paid yet.
Oh no, that happens often! Since you mentioned the payment hasn't gone through, you are safe. Just let us know if you want us to fix this up for you.
Yes, please don't process the payment for the wrong item. I would rather just have this order voided so I can start over with the correct size.
Understood. I will cancel the unpaid invoice so it does not go through, and you can place a new order for the large grinder whenever you are ready.
Hey, I just got my skincare set and the bottles are way too small for the photos. I already opened a PayPal dispute for this, so please take care of it there.
I'm so sorry to hear that is a mismatch. I will review your open PayPal dispute and respond to it directly in their system by end of day tomorrow to resolve this for you.
Thanks, I hope that works out. I just need the product to match what I paid for.
Hi, I just opened my new cast iron pan package and the handle is completely missing. I need a replacement sent out as soon as possible since I can't use it otherwise.

I am very sorry to hear that your order arrived incomplete. Unfortunately, our company policy strictly prohibits sending replacements for missing parts on unopened or newly used cookware without a prior quality control check at our facility, so I cannot ship you a new handle.
That seems unfair. I didn't break it, it was just not in the box. Can you please escalate this or authorize a return so I can get my money back or the correct item?

I understand your frustration, but I still cannot process a return or refund for this specific issue as it falls outside our current return guidelines for missing components. I am unable to assist further with this request.

I just unboxed the coffee grinder and it looks completely different from the product photos. The burrs are clearly plastic, not the ceramic ones advertised, and the build quality feels very cheap. This is not what I ordered.

I'm so sorry to hear about this mismatch. If you can send us a clear photo of the grinder's interior burrs within the next 48 hours, we will refund $24.50 to your original payment method and issue $10 in store credit as an apology for this error.
That works for me. I will take the photos and upload them to my account right now so you can verify the issue.
Hi, I just checked my bank statement and noticed I was charged twice for my new wireless earbuds this morning. The amount was $75 each time, totaling $150.
I'm so sorry to hear about the double charge. I see the duplicate transaction on our end and I will refund $75 to your original payment method to correct this.
Thank you, that is exactly what I needed. How long should I expect it to take for the money to show up back in my account?
It usually takes 3 to 5 business days to appear in your account. Please reach out to us again if you don't see it by then.
Hi, I bought the self-cleaning water bottle last Tuesday but the LED light stopped turning on yesterday and I can't get it to clean properly anymore.
I'm sorry to hear that your bottle isn't working as expected. We will accept the return and send you a prepaid return label by email shortly so you can ship it back to us.
Thanks, that sounds fine. How long does it usually take to get the label?
It should arrive in your inbox within the next hour. Please let us know if you don't receive it by then.
Hi, my order just arrived but the bottom zip of the backpack is completely torn open. It's unusable right now.
I'm so sorry to hear that! If you can send us a photo of the damage, I will have a new one shipped out to you immediately.
Sure, attaching the photo now. The fabric looks frayed and the zipper pull is missing too.
Thanks for that. I've seen the issue, and I will ship a replacement unit to this address by tomorrow morning.
Hi, I just noticed I was charged twice for the same yoga mat. Can you check my account because that's $40 extra gone in one go.
I am so sorry about that inconvenience. Let me pull up your transaction history to see exactly what happened with those two charges right now.
Okay, I'm waiting to hear from you. I didn't order two mats, just one, so this really needs to be sorted out quickly.
You are right, there was a system error. I will cancel the order before it ships to stop the second charge from going through.
Hi, I tried to cancel my photo editing app subscription last week but it seems to have renewed and charged me again. Can you help?
I'm sorry to hear that. I will cancel your subscription immediately so you won't be charged for any future periods.
Thanks. So when will that cancellation go through and stop the upcoming bills?
The cancellation is effective right now, so no further charges will be processed for this account.
Alright, I hope this solves the issue. Let me know if you need anything else from my side.
Hi, I just noticed I accidentally added a water bottle to my order that I didn't want. Is there anything I can do since the order just went through?
No worries at all! I will issue you $25 in store credit before tomorrow at 5 PM for that item.
That works for me. I actually need the credit for a different item I was eyeing. Thanks for the quick help.
You are very welcome! Just check your email tomorrow morning to confirm the credit is in your account.
Hi, my poster finally arrived this morning, but I noticed my card was charged twice for the same order. Can you help me sort that out?
I'm sorry to hear the delivery took so long. I see the duplicate charge on your account. Please reply with the last four digits of the card you used, and I will reverse the extra charge for you.
Thanks, the last four digits are 1234. Let me know when that's done.
Hi, I just realized I ordered the wrong vase by mistake. I have an open PayPal dispute regarding this. Can you help me sort it out?
I see the dispute. I will review the details there and respond to your messages within 24 hours.
Thanks, I'll wait for your reply in the dispute center.

Hi, I just opened my latest snack box and it doesn't match the description at all. There were no nuts in it even though that's what I signed up for, and half the items were expired. Can you please send me a replacement box or refund the money for this month?

Hi there, I am really sorry to hear that your experience wasn't up to our standards and that the contents didn't meet your expectations. We value your feedback and will make sure to pass this along to our quality control team, but we are unable to process a refund, replacement, or any other adjustments for this specific order.

That is honestly ridiculous. I paid for a specific type of snack box and got the wrong items. I feel like I'm being ripped off. Since you won't fix this, I'm going to leave a negative review and contact my bank to dispute the charge because I did not receive the goods as described.
Hi, I just opened my package and the bottom right corner of the poster is completely cut off. I can't see the text or the image there. Can you help?
I'm so sorry to hear that, that sounds terrible. I will ship a replacement poster to you right away, provided you send us a photo of the damaged item so we can log the issue.
Okay, that works. I just took a photo and attached it to my account dashboard. It clearly shows the missing section.
Thanks for the photo, I've verified the damage. Since the original item is defective, I will refund $15 to your original payment method for the cost of the shipping and handling fee you paid.

messages.text: Hey, my new mechanical keyboard stopped typing letters after just one week. The spacebar works but nothing else does. What's going on?
I'm sorry to hear that. It sounds like a hardware defect. Could you please try plugging it into a different USB port to rule out a connection issue?
I tried a different port on my laptop and another computer, but it's still dead. I need this fixed or I need my money back.
That confirms it's a faulty unit. I will refund $15 to your original payment method by the end of this week.
Okay, that works for me. Thanks for sorting this out quickly.
Hi, I just realized I ordered the wrong size case for my phone. I sent a medium instead of a large. Can I return it?
Sorry about the mix-up! We will accept the return and send you a prepaid shipping label to bring it back. Please have it shipped out by next Friday.
That sounds good. Is there anything else I need to do to make sure it goes through?
No, just make sure the item is still in its original packaging. We will email the label to you shortly so you can print it out.
Hey, I bought your smart water bottle last week and the temperature display just died this morning. It won't turn on at all.
I'm really sorry to hear that, that's definitely not the experience we want. Could you please check if the charging contacts are clean and if the battery indicator lights up when you plug it in?
I cleaned the contacts and tried charging it for an hour, but it still shows nothing. It seems completely broken.
Thanks for checking that. Since it's clearly defective, we will ship a replacement unit to your address by Friday so you can keep using our product without interruption.
Hi, I just opened the package for my wireless earbuds and the left one is cracked with the driver hanging out. It's completely unusable. Please let me know how to fix this.

I am so sorry to hear about the damage. That is definitely not the standard we aim for. Could you please send us a few photos of the cracked earbud and the outer box so our team can review the incident?
Here are the photos as requested. The crack goes right through the plastic shell and the mesh is torn. I need this sorted out as soon as possible since I need them for work this week.
Thank you for the pictures. Upon reviewing them, I can see significant shipping damage. I will cancel the order before it ships so that you can immediately reorder a fresh pair.
Hi, I just opened my new strategy game box and realized the blue resource tokens and the rulebook are missing from inside. I need to know what to do next.
I’m so sorry to hear that your game arrived incomplete. I can see it’s a top-up package you signed up for, so I will cancel your subscription to stop any further charges.
Thank you for handling that. Do you have any idea how I can actually get the missing pieces so I can play the game?

I understand your frustration. Our system is automated for shipping issues like this, so I recommend checking with your shipping provider to see if the box was tampered with or if you can file a claim with them directly for the missing items.
Hey, I cancelled my yoga mat subscription last month but I was just charged again this week. Can you look into why this keeps happening?
I'm sorry to hear that. Our system sometimes has a sync delay. Could you please send me a screenshot of the billing statement showing the latest charge?
Sure, here is the screenshot. It shows the charge going through on the 3rd of this month.
Thanks. I will issue you $25 in store credit by Friday if you reply to confirm you have received this message.
Hey, my coffee grinder finally showed up yesterday, but I noticed I was charged $85 instead of the $75 price it was supposed to be. Can you look into that?
I'm so sorry about the delay with your grinder! I've taken a look at your order and I can see the price difference. That was definitely an error on our end.
Yeah, I know it was, but I really don't want to have to call my bank to dispute this. I just want the extra ten dollars back in my account soon.
I will issue the correction for the $10 difference and ensure the refund is processed to your original payment method by the end of this week.
Thank you, that sounds good. I'll keep an eye out for it then.
Hi, my earbuds finally just arrived today. They were supposed to get here two days ago. I'm pretty frustrated with the delay.
I am really sorry about the wait. Since you have an open PayPal dispute, I will respond to that case directly and handle the matter there as soon as possible.
Honestly, I wasn't planning to keep them if I had known how late they'd be. I left the dispute open hoping you'd just fix this quickly here.
I understand your frustration. As mentioned, the best way to resolve this specific issue is through the platform you are already using, so I will ensure my response is posted there shortly.
Alright, I guess I'll wait for your reply in the portal. Please make sure to address the late delivery since that was the main problem.

Hi, I thought I cancelled my poster subscription last week, but I just got charged again. I've been getting these printed posters I don't want even after sending the cancellation email. Can you help me stop this?
Sorry to hear that. To look into this, could you please send us a photo of the charge details and your order number? Once I have those, I'll check what's going on with your account settings.

Here is the screenshot of the charge and my order number is #89201. I really just want this to stop because I already have a subscription active elsewhere. I sent the cancellation request three times already.
